title: Halloween at the Parks
intro: [excited] Welcome, foolish mortals, to a Halloween episode of Disney Jeopardy! Grab your candy bag, your costume, and maybe a flashlight. [whispers] The ghosts are keeping score tonight. [laughs]

art.prompt: A moonlit theme-park street at Halloween lined with glowing jack-o'-lanterns and orange string lights, a gothic mansion on a hill behind wrought-iron gates, bats swirling past a full moon, wisps of fog, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Trick-or-Treat Theater
categories.intro: First, the movies we rewatch every October. [chuckles] Pass the popcorn and lock the door.

art.prompt: A cozy living room movie night on Halloween: a bowl of popcorn, a black-flame candle, a spell book with a brass clasp, a carved pumpkin glowing on the windowsill, a stormy night outside, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Hocus Pocus takes place on Halloween night in this Massachusetts town famous for its witch history.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Salem! A great town to visit in October. [whispers] Just don't light any candles you find in old houses.

clues.clue: In Hocus Pocus, young Thackery Binx is cursed to live forever as this animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a black cat! Three hundred years of talking cat life. [laughs] And still no one fed him on time.

clues.clue: In the 2005 Disney Channel movie Twitches, real-life twin Tia Mowry plays one twin witch. This sister plays the other.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tamera Mowry! Twins playing twins. [chuckles] Casting was suspiciously easy.

clues.clue: In Halloweentown, Marnie learns she's a witch from her grandmother Aggie, played by this Singin' in the Rain legend.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Debbie Reynolds! She played Aggie Cromwell in four Halloweentown movies. [excited] Now that's a grandma with range.

clues.clue: In Hocus Pocus, Winifred poisoned her old flame Billy Butcherson and then sewed this shut so he couldn't spill her secrets.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his mouth! [laughs] When Billy finally cuts the stitches, the first thing he does is cough up three hundred years of moths.

categories.title: Not-So-Scary Nights
categories.intro: Next, the after-hours party at Magic Kingdom where the scariest thing is the line for candy. [laughs]

art.prompt: A fairy-tale castle at night bathed in orange and purple light, Halloween fireworks bursting overhead, a parade route lined with pumpkins and candy corn colored bunting, mist on the street, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: At Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party, guests in costume collect this from treat stations all around Magic Kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is candy! Bring a big bag. [whispers] A really big bag. Grown-ups trick-or-treat too, no judgment.

clues.clue: Riding down Main Street on horseback with a flaming jack-o'-lantern, this rider gallops out just before the Boo-to-You Parade.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Headless Horseman! He rides straight out of 1949's The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad. [laughs] He never needs a hat.

clues.clue: Since 2019, Disneyland Resort's after-hours Halloween party, Oogie Boogie Bash, has been held in this park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney California Adventure! Named for the boogie man himself from The Nightmare Before Christmas. [chuckles] Roll the dice!

clues.clue: From 2005 to 2018, this Haunted Mansion-inspired fireworks show lit up the sky over Magic Kingdom during the party.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is HalloWishes! Hosted by the Ghost Host with a choir of villains. [sighs] We still miss it.

clues.clue: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party first haunted Magic Kingdom in this year, as a one-night event.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1995! Just one night, on Halloween itself. [excited] Now it runs for weeks, starting before summer is even over.

categories.title: Room for One More
categories.intro: Now, a whole category inside the Haunted Mansion. [whispers] There's always room for one more contestant.

art.prompt: A dusty gothic foyer lit by a single candelabra, a long hallway of portraits with following eyes, cobwebs on a grand staircase, a crystal ball glowing on a seance table, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: The Ghost Host tells guests the Haunted Mansion is home to this many happy haunts.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 999! There's room for a thousand. [laughs] Any volunteers?

clues.clue: In the stretching room, one portrait reveals a young woman with a parasol balanced on a tightrope above this snapping creature.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an alligator! [gasps] Hold that parasol steady, ma'am.

clues.clue: Guests ride through the Haunted Mansion in black clamshell ride vehicles with this spooky name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Doom Buggies! Technically they run on Disney's Omnimover system. [chuckles] But Doom Buggy is way more fun to say.

clues.clue: Removed from Disneyland's attic soon after the ride opened in 1969, this ghost with a disappearing head returned in 2015.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Hatbox Ghost! The head-swapping effect didn't work in 1969. [excited] Forty-six years later, technology finally caught up.

clues.clue: This voice actor, also known as the voice of Boris Badenov, recorded the Ghost Host's famous narration.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Paul Frees! [whispers] Is this a haunted room, or is it your imagination? [laughs] Thurl Ravenscroft, by the way, is one of the singing busts.

categories.title: Spirited Facades
categories.intro: Picture time! Every photo is a real haunt from a Disney park somewhere in the world. [chuckles] Identify the spooky address.

art.prompt: A row of tiny glowing haunted houses on shelves like a model collection, each in a different style: southern mansion, gothic manor, crumbling hotel tower, western mansion on a mesa, Victorian estate, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: This Southern-style mansion opened at Disneyland in 1969. Name the attraction inside.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Haunted Mansion! It sits in New Orleans Square and looks perfectly lovely on the outside. [whispers] That's how they get you.

clues.clue: This crumbling Hollywood landmark at Disney's Hollywood Studios hides a runaway elevator. Name the hotel.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Hollywood Tower Hotel, home of the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror! [gasps] Check-out time is... immediately.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's mansion, unlike Disneyland's, is styled after Dutch Gothic manors of this New York river valley.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Hudson River Valley! Sleepy Hollow country. [chuckles] Fitting, since it sits in colonial Liberty Square.

clues.clue: In this Hong Kong Disneyland mansion, a magic music box brings Lord Henry's collection to life. His monkey Albert opened it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mystic Manor! No ghosts at all, just a mischievous monkey and a very bad idea. [laughs] Albert, put that down!

clues.clue: This Wild West haunted manor in Disneyland Paris opened with the park in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1992! Phantom Manor opened with Euro Disneyland that April. [whispers] Its ghostly bride still waits on Thunder Mesa.

categories.title: Costume Contest
categories.intro: Finally, a costume contest! I show you the colors of a famous Disney costume, you name who's wearing it. [excited] Best dressed wins.

art.prompt: A costume shop at Halloween: racks of colorful capes and gowns, a mannequin wearing a sparkly cape, hat boxes, fabric swatches in every color spread on a worktable, a jack-o'-lantern by the mirror, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Hint: she bit a poisoned apple. Name the costume.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White! Blue bodice, yellow skirt, red bow. [laughs] Every Halloween, a thousand tiny Snow Whites ring your doorbell.

clues.clue: Hint: this space ranger thinks he can fly. Name the costume.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear! White, lime green and purple. [excited] To infinity and the candy bowl!

clues.clue: Hint: she wasn't invited to the christening. Name the costume.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maleficent! Black robes, purple trim and green fire. [whispers] Horns sold separately.

clues.clue: Hint: her green glasses are iconic and her family's house is magical. Name the costume.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mirabel Madrigal! White blouse, teal skirt and embroidery in every color. [laughs] We don't talk about the price of the embroidery.

clues.clue: Hint: this top-hatted villain has friends on the other side. Name the costume.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dr. Facilier, the Shadow Man! Deep purple coat, black hat, bone-white skull. [chuckles] Accessories include one very sneaky shadow.
